envelope.transferabilityNotes: The EUR-11 EURO-CORDEX domain's published approximate rectangular extent (about 22W–45E, 27N–72N), not its exact rotated-pole grid footprint, which is not a rectangle in true lat/lon at all. A deliberate simplification.

CLMS product coverage, as a coarse bounding extent rather than a country-by-country outline: the precise boundary is a property of the CLMS product and is better dereferenced from CLMS than restated approximately here. The product's exclusion of Ukraine is a separate constraint (`clms-excluded-ukraine`) rather than a hole in this one — an exclusion carved into a geometry is invisible to a reader and easy to lose in simplification, whereas a named constraint a rule cites is neither.

Ukraine's approximate bounding extent, which CLMS coverage excludes. Cited by a rule with test `inside`, so falling within it is what makes the component unexecutable. Coarse: a bounding box over Ukraine also covers parts of neighbouring countries, so this errs toward flagging a target that may in fact be covered — the safe direction for a portability check, but it needs the authoritative CLMS geometry before it is relied on.
Discrete temporal epochs, explicitly not a time series: one timestep per epoch. 2022–2025 available at time of writing.

artifacts.artifact: median summer LST datasets (FOCAL STAC, Landsat 5/7/8/9-derived)
CLMS Tree Cover Density / Imperviousness Density
Eurostat census / socio-economic data (planned Heat Risk Indicator)
artifacts.transferabilityNotes: Not yet implemented; the envisaged replacement should follow a schema compatible with Eurostat's.

rules.transferabilityNotes: Inside the EURO-CORDEX domain the datasets are reused unchanged, by changing the area of interest.

Outside it, compatible LST datasets must be generated or preprocessed if possible; if none can be produced, this component cannot be executed for the target. Which of the two applies depends on whether a substitute is obtainable, which the source does not resolve.
Outside CLMS coverage no substitute is currently defined, and hot-spot characterization, which uses this dataset, cannot be executed.

Within the CLMS bounding extent but inside the area the product excludes: no Tree Cover Density or Imperviousness Density data exists, and no substitute is defined, so hot-spot characterization cannot be executed. A terminal outcome with no alternative offered, unlike the coverage rule above.

Stated with triggeredBy rather than a cited constraint: this data is not yet implemented, so there is no envelope fact to point at. Once built, the planned Heat Risk Indicator would not be executable without it.
